family_reports.body: Went in as a DV victim and mother who raised her 2 kids only to be subjected to half a million dollars to even see my kids. Removed to father who don’t even take of them.
Traumatized the children, destroyed their childhoods and bankrupt me all in the name of greed.

Richland Family Court is a chess board of paid players and you are a pawn. They bring in more actors at your expense (for no justified reason), prolonging the game and padding their "friends" pockets. It's sad, abusive, and has damaged my children and me financially and emotionally.
It has taken everything from me, torn my family apart at a cost/debt that will be paid ultimately by my children. Everyone close to me has been affectedband are at a lose.
